requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with 6K Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed bottles supporting 6K page yield for Black and CMY inks, with CMY bottle size greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: Keyed bottles ensure compatibility and prevent errors; higher yield meets customer demand for efficiency and reduces replacement frequency.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, ink compatibility, manufacturing tooling
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the printer is loaded with NGB keyed bottles, when printing, then Black and CMY bottles must deliver 6K pages each, with CMY bottle size >8K.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure that the ink bottle and tank system is designed for spill-free operation during installation and use.
requirements.Rationale: Spill-free operation improves user experience and reduces mess and maintenance issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a user installs or replaces a bottle, when the process completes, then no ink spills should occur.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a NOA-F component with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhanced NOA-F design improves reliability and serviceability; maintaining mechanisms ensures compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given the NOA-F is installed, when operated, then the metal foiled labyrinth and lid label must be present and functional, and push-push/TDF unchanged.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA
requirements.Description: Reuse the SuperAmp Si PHA component from previous models in the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Reuse reduces cost and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer assembly, when SuperAmp Si PHA is used, then it must operate reliably as in prior models.

requirements.Title: Reuse Magi/Nessie Ink (No Reformulation)
requirements.Description: Use existing Magi and Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Avoids additional R&D and ensures ink consistency across platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer uses Magi/Nessie inks, when printing, then ink performance must match prior models without reformulation.

requirements.Title: Reliability and IDS Characterization
requirements.Description: Characterize and model reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System), including startup and NOA-F end-of-life.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust system performance and longevity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given IDS system, when tested, then reliability, WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and EOL must meet defined benchmarks.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in tank and assess impact on Print Quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Stable ink ensures consistent PQ and reduces maintenance issues.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given ink in tank, when modeling is performed, then stability must be demonstrated and PQ impact assessed.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Support NOA-F as service parts for warranty claims and repairs.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for customers under warranty.
requirements.Stakeholders: Service Centers, Warranty Team, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a warranty claim, when NOA-F replacement is required, then service parts must be available and replaceable.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the printer lid.
requirements.Rationale: Acumen 6 provides advanced monitoring or security features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given printer assembly, when lid is inspected, then Acumen 6 must be present and functional.

requirements.Title: Factory Configuration Modifications
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and ensure PHA, Dry FI, USG, and push-push are assembled in printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: Factory modifications enable production of new features and components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given factory operations, when producing Magellan printers, then SA14 line and Orcus 5 must be modified as specified.

requirements.Title: ISDO Capex for New Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Invest in ISDO Capex for SA14 line, Magi/Nessie ink cart, labelling tool in Orcus 5, and molds for 1-4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Capex investment is needed for new production requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Capex plan, when implemented, then production lines and molds for new keyed caps must be operational.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt LE / Marconi Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Watt LE and Marconi Hi mechanical platforms and CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System) for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Reuse proven platforms to reduce development time and investment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan design, when assembled, then Watt LE/Marconi Hi Mech and CISS must be integrated.

requirements.Title: Print Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Support print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm), with PDL (Page Description Language) speeds of 25/19ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive print speeds are required for market positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when printing, then speeds must meet 25/20ppm and PDL 25/19ppm.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA and NOA-F to be customer replaceable.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user convenience and reduces service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given a user, when PHA or NOA-F replacement is needed, then user must be able to replace without technical support.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal: 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Extended warranty page life reduces TCO and increases customer satisfaction.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Warranty Team, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when under warranty, then printer must reliably print up to 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS
requirements.Description: Provide SKU 2 with high performance and high PDL, available as Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).
requirements.Rationale: SKU diversification and PaaS offering increases market flexibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given SKU 2, when offered, then it must support Hi + Hi PDL and be available as PaaS.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Tank Size Increase
requirements.Description: Increase tank size for Reddington ID variant, with no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Larger tank increases page yield and reduces refill frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Reddington ID printer, when tank is inspected, then size must be increased without affecting ADF.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: EPS foam provides better protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when packaged, then EPS foam must be used as primary packaging material.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, Blue Angel Requirements for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure PDL SKU meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental and sustainability requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Compliance with environmental standards increases market acceptance and regulatory compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given PDL SKU, when certified, then EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel requirements must be met.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize size.
requirements.Rationale: Tray modifications ensure compatibility with increased tank size and optimize printer footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when trays are inspected, then they must accommodate tank protrusion and be optimized for size.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Larger display improves usability and access to features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when powered on, then 4.3” CGD must be available and functional.

requirements.Title: Platform with 4 Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes, implement new tube routing and integration for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: Improved tube routing enhances ink delivery efficiency and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when assembled, then Sayan Sibstar tubes and new routing must be present and functional.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement service station aerosol management with spit platform changes due to tank.
requirements.Rationale: Aerosol management reduces contamination and improves maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when serviced, then aerosol management system must function effectively.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model
requirements.Description: Model carriage dynamics and forces considering tube and new weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable print operation and prevents mechanical failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when tested, then carriage dynamics must meet reliability standards with new tube weights.

requirements.Title: Paperpath for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design paperpath to support increased page life goal (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Paperpath durability is critical for extended printer life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when tested, then paperpath must reliably support 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post 80k Life)
requirements.Description: Make ink maintenance a serviceable part for service centers after 80,000 page life.
requirements.Rationale: Serviceability post-warranty extends product life and reduces waste.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance part design, service center training
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when page life exceeds 80k, then ink maintenance must be serviceable by authorized centers.

requirements.Title: 140ml K Bottles and xx ml CMY Bottles
requirements.Description: Provide 140ml Black (K) bottles and new xx ml CMY bottles for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Larger bottle sizes reduce refill frequency and meet high yield requirements.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Supply Chain, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when bottles are loaded, then 140ml K and xx ml CMY bottles must be accepted and functional.

requirements.Title: IDS New Make-break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection for IDS (Ink Delivery System), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: New connections improve reliability and enable larger tank integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when IDS is assembled, then new make-break and FI connection must be present and functional.

requirements.Title: IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system.
requirements.Rationale: Improved startup and air management enhances reliability and prevents airlocks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when started, then IDS startup algorithm and air management must function reliably.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new servicing and startup algorithm for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: New algorithm improves serviceability and startup reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when serviced or started, then new algorithm must be used and function reliably.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals & Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality goals and define depletion criteria to meet page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent quality and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Dependencies: Print quality standards, page yield metrics
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when printing, then print quality must meet new goals and depletion must align with page yield definition.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Reuse reduces development cost and leverages proven electronics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when assembled, then specified components must be reused and functional.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Wi-Fi connectivity is essential for modern printers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when powered on, then Stingray Wi-Fi must be functional and connect to networks.

requirements.Title: FW Dune Firmware
requirements.Description: Use FW Dune firmware for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Specific firmware ensures compatibility with new hardware and features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when operated, then FW Dune firmware must be installed and functional.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features.
requirements.Rationale: Enhanced security is needed for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when operated, then Gauss4.xx security features must be active and functional.

requirements.Title: Business Model: Consumer, SMB, Enterprise
requirements.Description: Support business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments.
requirements.Rationale: Segmented business models increase market reach and flexibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when marketed, then business models for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise must be supported.

requirements.Title: Services: PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker
requirements.Description: Offer services including Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and support for WorkFromHome/Flexworker scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: Service offerings increase value proposition and address new work trends.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when deployed, then PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services must be available.

requirements.Title: Onboarding/S&O Path Support
requirements.Description: Support onboarding and S&O paths for Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: Streamlined onboarding increases customer satisfaction and reduces support costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when onboarding, then all specified paths must be supported.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Scanning is a required functionality for SMB and enterprise customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when operated, then scan solution must be available and functional.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability Solution
requirements.Description: Provide SMB manageability solution for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Manageability is critical for SMB customers to control and monitor printer usage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when deployed in SMB environment, then manageability solution must be available.

requirements.Title: Enterprise Support: WJA, HPSM, JAM
requirements.Description: Support enterprise solutions including WJA (Web JetAdmin), HPSM (HP Smart Manage), and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Enterprise customers require advanced support and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when deployed in enterprise, then WJA, HPSM, and JAM must be supported.

requirements.Title: Client & Driver Support: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Support clients and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Driver and client support ensures broad compatibility and ease of use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when installed, then all listed clients and drivers must be supported.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and Ink/Laser Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Design to protect HP’s Micro/SMB segments and safeguard traditional ink/laser profit pool from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Strategic protection of HP’s core business segments and profit pool.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when launched, then Micro/SMB segments must be protected and profit pool maintained.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise
requirements.Description: Position Magellan to lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in Medium and Enterprise segments, targeting Epson as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Strategic positioning to win market share from competitors.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when marketed, then positioning must align with LaserJet/PDL strategy.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand profitable CISS share by entering new segments.
requirements.Rationale: Growth in new segments increases revenue and market share.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when launched, then CISS share must grow in new segments.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform and Marconi-Hi Product
requirements.Description: Highly leverage Watt-LE mechanical platform and Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID) and solutions for Magellan.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost, leverages proven solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when developed, then Watt-LE and Marconi-Hi must be leveraged.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks into Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Integration improves reliability and efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when assembled, then CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks must be integrated.

requirements.Title: New NGB Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Keyed bottles prevent incorrect installation and improve user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when bottles are installed, then NGB keyed bottles must fit only compatible slots.

requirements.Title: Schedule Constraint
requirements.Description: Meet scheduled milestones as defined in HW, NOA-F, and Bottle checkpoints.
requirements.Rationale: Schedule adherence is critical for time-to-market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan project, when milestones are reached, then schedule must be adhered to as defined.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Constraint
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA component must have a life of at least 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Component durability is critical for warranty and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when tested, then SuperAmp PHA must last at least 65,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of Pages: 2 Years
requirements.Description: Support warranty life of pages for 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: Extended warranty increases customer trust and satisfaction.
requirements.Stakeholders: Warranty Team, End Users, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when under warranty, then page life must be supported for 2 years.

requirements.Title: Thruput 25/20 PDL
requirements.Description: Optimize throughput to 25/20 pages per minute for PDL.
requirements.Rationale: High throughput is needed for competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when printing, then throughput must be 25/20 PDL.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Optimize serviceability by providing a maintenance box.
requirements.Rationale: Maintenance box improves ease of servicing and reduces downtime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when serviced, then maintenance box must be accessible and functional.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize SMB solution for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Optimized SMB solution increases adoption and satisfaction in SMB segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when deployed in SMB, then solution must be optimized for SMB needs.

requirements.Title: PaaS Schedule Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize schedule for Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) offering.
requirements.Rationale: Timely PaaS launch increases competitive advantage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when PaaS is launched, then schedule must be optimized as planned.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Host a 12K-CMYK option for Magellan printer as a flexible priority.
requirements.Rationale: Flexible option increases product appeal and adaptability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when configured, then 12K-CMYK option must be available as needed.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible Priority)
requirements.Description: Offer trade page 6K option as a flexible priority for Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Flexible trade page option increases adaptability to market needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Given Magellan printer, when configured, then trade page 6K option must be available as needed.
